meta: Photo studios use AI to develop concepts and shoot plans: clients want great photos but can't describe them, and AI helps settle on the main idea early.

muc.title: Clients who can't describe it
muc.text: Clients want great photos but can't describe them. Studios use AI to settle on a concept, the main idea, right from the start.

muc.title: Three words, three ideas
muc.text: Ask the client for three words describing the feeling they want, then ask AI for three concepts with colors, outfits and settings.

muc.title: Split by time slot
muc.text: Once a concept is chosen, ask AI for a shoot plan by the hour, with poses, props and outfit changes.

muc.title: AI images are just for ideas
muc.text: Tell clients clearly that AI sample images are only for imagining; the real photos depend on the light on the day.

muc.title: A five-question form
muc.text: Ask AI for five questions to send clients before a shoot, to settle the concept faster.
